findings.title: Support multi-language (Spanish/French) automated notification emails
findings.description: All automated system emails (welcome/first-session prompt, session reminders, new-coach-message alerts) are sent in English only, regardless of the member's actual working language. Andes Mining's LatAm workforce (~1,800 enrolled, ~1,200 more comfortable in Spanish) largely ignores or discards these emails because they read as not-for-them or spam, producing a 28-point activation gap versus the English-speaking North American population (79% vs 51%). The in-app experience and coach-matched sessions are already available in Spanish and are not the problem; the gap is specifically at the outbound notification layer. Customer requests emails rendered in the member's own language, driven by a per-member language preference, prioritizing Spanish and also French (for a French-speaking African joint-venture population of a few hundred members).
findings.quote: Multi-language notification emails. Send the automated emails in the member's language, not just English.
findings.severity_reason: Feature gap is directly correlated with a measured 28-point activation gap and throttles engagement for over 1,000 members in the customer's largest, highest-growth, highest-priority (safety-leadership) population; no product-side workaround exists, only a manual customer-run substitute that lacks functional booking links.
findings.match_note: No catalogue issue addresses notification language/localization; PROJ-101 (timezone display) and other tracked items are unrelated to email language content, so this is a new feature request.

findings.title: Customer-run manual Spanish email workaround (HR-sent, non-scalable)
findings.description: Diego's HR team manually sends their own Spanish-language emails pointing members back to the platform, as a stopgap for the English-only notification problem. He states this is manual, does not scale, and lacks the functional booking links the real notifications carry, so it cannot substitute for a real fix.
findings.quote: We've tried sending our own Spanish emails from my HR team pointing people back to the platform, but it's manual and it doesn't scale
findings.severity_reason: Not a separate product issue; it is evidence/context for the multi-language notification feature request already captured, not something requiring independent engineering action.
findings.match_note: This is the customer's own workaround for the multi-language notification issue raised at L38, not a distinct product problem; filed as workaround_request tied to that line.
